hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/prompt-guard.py"; if [ -f "$f" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$f"; else exit 0; fi

f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/write-guard.py"; if [ -f "$f" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$f"; else echo "Guards: OFF. The key guard cannot run, so this action is blocked. Tell the Owner." >&2; exit 2; fi

f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/bash-guard.py"; if [ -f "$f" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$f"; else echo "Guards: OFF. The key guard cannot run, so this action is blocked. Tell the Owner." >&2; exit 2; fi
